essence: Flame wrapped around a knife; chaos shaped into protection; tenderness hidden behind swagger. She loves loudly, protects fiercely, and softens only for Luna.
open: Sister to Torie Eriksson — the sibling link lives in the master index and on neither profile.
note: ALICE MEADOWS — no Cassidy anywhere in this family, and the Archive said it twice before anyone corrected it. THE BRATTY CHEF: she is why thirty-four people eat home-cooked instead of takeaway, every day, and every restaurant-grade appliance crowding the long counter is something she asked for. SHE PLATES A SMALLER PORTION FOR SIR TRASHMUFFIN because he is a resident and does not get counted in the thirty-four, and she will deny it. SHE CARVED EVERY ANNIVERSARY into the kitchen doorframe with her own knife because nobody else's handwriting was precise enough; Luna corrected two with a pen and nobody talks about it. SHE HAD THE LIBRARY TOWER BUILT FOR LUNA — looked at the blueprint, looked at her wife, said SHE NEEDS A TOWER — and at three in the morning Luna takes her up the rolling ladder in it and reminds her exactly who built it and why. AND SHE CARRIES THE MARK: she is a citizen, she never went through those walls, and in Arc 1 Livi gave her the whole account of what Bryn did in there and Alice went and asked to be marked as one of hers.
correction: Luna — situationally, and only when the ambience needed saving. Roughly half the time the ambience needed Alice.
